integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only the published definitions, homogeneity in the test function, and the literal quantified domains. No finite experiment is used to infer an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The result proves a necessary normalization/domain correction for the variational statements in version 1; it does not prove that the corresponding unit-ball theorem is valid with the published constants.
The result does not address the paper's strong-form QPINN lazy-training theorem or finite training-vector statements.
title: Unbounded test-space scaling makes the variational QPINN normalization degenerate
